notes: Long white panel over the entrance of the regional council building, Timbuktu; black ministry line, green italic 'HOTEL DE REGION', blue name line, small contact line (spacing as printed). notes: Painted cooperative sign on posts at Nintabougoro village, with a pointing-hand arrow to the left; 'BENKADI' in French guillemets. The 'BENKADI' logo badge repeats the name.
